config.py

"""Central place for all tunable settings of the application."""

# ----------------------------
# Export settings
# ----------------------------

# Name of the generated file (also skipped when collecting, so it is never re-exported).
OUTPUT_FILE_NAME = "project_code.txt"

# Ask for confirmation when a project has more files than this.
WARNING_FILE_LIMIT = 2000

# Directories that are never exported.
IGNORE_DIRS = {
    ".git",
    ".idea",
    ".vscode",
    "__pycache__",
    "venv",
    ".venv",
    "node_modules",
    "dist",
    "build",
}

# File names that are never exported.
IGNORE_FILES = {
    OUTPUT_FILE_NAME,
}

# Only files with these extensions are exported.
INCLUDE_EXTENSIONS = {
    ".py", ".js", ".ts", ".tsx", ".jsx",
    ".html", ".css",
    ".json", ".yaml", ".yml", ".toml",
    ".md", ".txt", ".sql", ".xml",
    ".cs", ".csproj", ".sln",
    ".java", ".kt",
    ".cpp", ".c", ".h", ".hpp",
    ".php", ".go", ".rs",
    ".swift", ".dart",
}

# ----------------------------
# UI settings
# ----------------------------

# Maximum number of characters shown in the preview.
# Copying and saving always use the full text.
PREVIEW_LIMIT = 200_000

FONT = "Segoe UI"
CODE_FONT = "Consolas"



============================================================
exporter.py
============================================================

"""Core logic: finding project files, reading them and building the export text."""

from pathlib import Path

from config import (
    IGNORE_DIRS,
    IGNORE_FILES,
    INCLUDE_EXTENSIONS,
    OUTPUT_FILE_NAME,
    WARNING_FILE_LIMIT,
)

# Encodings tried in order when reading a file.
ENCODINGS = ("utf-8", "utf-8-sig", "cp1250", "latin-1")


def should_ignore(relative_path: Path) -> bool:
    """True if any part of the path (relative to the project root) is an ignored directory."""
    return any(part in IGNORE_DIRS for part in relative_path.parts)


def read_file(file: Path) -> str:
    """Reads a text file, trying several encodings before giving up."""
    for encoding in ENCODINGS:
        try:
            return file.read_text(encoding=encoding)
        except (UnicodeDecodeError, OSError):
            continue

    return "[The file could not be read]"


def format_header(relative_path) -> str:
    """Header printed above every file in the export."""
    line = "=" * 60
    return f"{line}\n{relative_path}\n{line}\n\n"


def collect_files(folder):
    """Yields (relative_path, content) for every file that should be exported."""
    root = Path(folder)

    for file in sorted(root.rglob("*")):
        if not file.is_file():
            continue

        if file.name in IGNORE_FILES:
            continue

        # Check the path relative to the root, so that a project living inside
        # e.g. "C:\\build\\app" is not ignored entirely.
        if should_ignore(file.relative_to(root)):
            continue

        if file.suffix.lower() not in INCLUDE_EXTENSIONS:
            continue

        yield file.relative_to(root), read_file(file)


def files_to_text(files) -> str:
    """Joins (relative_path, content) pairs into the final export text."""
    parts = []

    for relative_path, content in files:
        parts.append(format_header(relative_path))
        parts.append(content)
        parts.append("\n\n\n")

    return "".join(parts)


def default_output_path(folder) -> Path:
    """Default location of the exported file: inside the project folder."""
    return Path(folder) / OUTPUT_FILE_NAME


def save_text(path, text: str) -> Path:
    """Writes the export text to the given file path and returns that path."""
    output_file = Path(path)
    output_file.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")

    return output_file


def analyze_project(folder):
    """
    Quickly counts files and directories.

    Returns:
        (files_count, directories_count, limit_exceeded)
    """
    root = Path(folder)

    files = 0
    directories = 0

    for item in root.rglob("*"):
        if should_ignore(item.relative_to(root)):
            continue

        if item.is_dir():
            directories += 1

        elif item.is_file():
            files += 1

            # Stop counting once the warning limit is exceeded.
            if files > WARNING_FILE_LIMIT:
                return files, directories, True

    return files, directories, False



============================================================
gui.py
============================================================

"""Main window: choose a project folder and generate the export."""

import customtkinter as ctk
from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox

from config import FONT
from exporter import analyze_project, collect_files
from result_window import ResultWindow

MUTED_TEXT = ("gray35", "gray70")


def run():
    ctk.set_appearance_mode("System")  # follow the OS light/dark setting
    ctk.set_default_color_theme("blue")

    app = ctk.CTk()
    app.title("Project Code Exporter")
    app.geometry("640x300")
    app.resizable(False, False)

    path_var = ctk.StringVar()  # selected project folder
    status_var = ctk.StringVar(value="Ready")

    # ---- Actions ----

    def browse():
        """Lets the user pick the project folder."""
        folder = filedialog.askdirectory()

        if folder:
            path_var.set(folder)

    def confirm_large_project(files_count, directories):
        """Asks whether to continue with a very large project."""
        return messagebox.askyesno(
            "Large Project",
            f"The selected project contains more than {files_count:,} files\n"
            f"in at least {directories:,} directories.\n\n"
            "Exporting such a large directory may take a long time.\n\n"
            "Do you want to continue?"
        )

    def generate():
        """Collects the project files and opens the result window."""
        folder = path_var.get().strip()

        # Validate the input before touching the file system.
        if not folder:
            messagebox.showwarning("Warning", "Select a project folder.")
            return

        files_count, directories, limit_exceeded = analyze_project(folder)

        if limit_exceeded and not confirm_large_project(files_count, directories):
            return

        # Show progress while collecting.
        status_var.set("Generating...")
        generate_btn.configure(state="disabled")
        progress.pack(fill="x", padx=30, pady=(0, 6))
        progress.start()
        app.update_idletasks()

        try:
            files = list(collect_files(folder))
        except Exception as error:
            status_var.set("Export failed.")
            messagebox.showerror("Error", str(error))
            return
        finally:
            # Always restore the UI, whether collecting succeeded or not.
            progress.stop()
            progress.pack_forget()
            generate_btn.configure(state="normal")

        status_var.set(f"Done ✓ {len(files):,} files collected")
        ResultWindow(app, folder, files, status_var)

    # ---- Layout ----

    card = ctk.CTkFrame(app, corner_radius=14)
    card.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=20, pady=20)

    ctk.CTkLabel(
        card, text="Project Code Exporter", font=(FONT, 24, "bold")
    ).pack(pady=(18, 0))

    ctk.CTkLabel(
        card,
        text="Collect a project's source code into a single text file",
        font=(FONT, 13),
        text_color=MUTED_TEXT,
    ).pack(pady=(0, 14))

    # Folder row: entry + Browse button.
    row = ctk.CTkFrame(card, fg_color="transparent")
    row.pack(fill="x", padx=30)

    ctk.CTkEntry(
        row,
        textvariable=path_var,
        placeholder_text="Project folder...",
        height=38,
        corner_radius=10,
    ).pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=(0, 10))

    ctk.CTkButton(
        row, text="Browse", width=100, height=38, corner_radius=10, command=browse
    ).pack(side="right")

    generate_btn = ctk.CTkButton(
        card,
        text="Generate",
        width=220,
        height=42,
        corner_radius=10,
        font=(FONT, 15, "bold"),
        command=generate,
    )
    generate_btn.pack(pady=18)

    # Only packed while generating (see generate()).
    progress = ctk.CTkProgressBar(card, mode="indeterminate")

    ctk.CTkLabel(
        card, textvariable=status_var, font=(FONT, 12), text_color=MUTED_TEXT
    ).pack(pady=(0, 10))

    app.mainloop()



============================================================
highlight.py
============================================================

"""Syntax highlighting of the preview text (powered by Pygments)."""

import customtkinter as ctk
from pygments import lex
from pygments.lexers import TextLexer, get_lexer_for_filename
from pygments.token import Token
from pygments.util import ClassNotFound

from config import PREVIEW_LIMIT
from exporter import format_header

# Colors per token type as (light theme, dark theme).
# Token types not listed here inherit the color of their nearest listed parent.
SYNTAX_COLORS = {
    Token.Comment: ("#6a737d", "#6a9955"),
    Token.Keyword: ("#af00db", "#c586c0"),
    Token.Keyword.Constant: ("#0000ff", "#569cd6"),
    Token.Operator.Word: ("#af00db", "#c586c0"),
    Token.Literal.String: ("#a31515", "#ce9178"),
    Token.Literal.Number: ("#098658", "#b5cea8"),
    Token.Name.Function: ("#795e26", "#dcdcaa"),
    Token.Name.Class: ("#267f99", "#4ec9b0"),
    Token.Name.Decorator: ("#795e26", "#dcdcaa"),
    Token.Name.Builtin: ("#0070c1", "#4fc1ff"),
    Token.Name.Tag: ("#800000", "#569cd6"),
    Token.Name.Attribute: ("#e50000", "#9cdcfe"),
    Token.Name.Exception: ("#267f99", "#4ec9b0"),
    Token.Operator: ("#5a5a5a", "#d4d4d4"),
    Token.Generic.Heading: ("#0070c1", "#569cd6"),
}

# Color of the file name headers and of the "truncated" note.
HEADER_COLOR = ("#0b5cad", "#6cb6ff")
HEADER_TAG = "header"


def _tag_for(token_type):
    """Returns the tag name for a token type, or None if it should stay uncolored."""
    # Walk up the token hierarchy until a colored type is found.
    while token_type not in SYNTAX_COLORS:
        if token_type is Token:
            return None
        token_type = token_type.parent

    return str(token_type)


def _lexer_for(file_name, content):
    """Picks a Pygments lexer by file name; plain text if the language is unknown."""
    try:
        return get_lexer_for_filename(str(file_name), content, stripnl=False)
    except ClassNotFound:
        return TextLexer(stripnl=False)


def _configure_tags(text_widget):
    """Registers one tk tag per color, matching the current light/dark theme."""
    index = 0 if ctk.get_appearance_mode() == "Light" else 1

    for token_type, colors in SYNTAX_COLORS.items():
        text_widget.tag_configure(str(token_type), foreground=colors[index])

    text_widget.tag_configure(HEADER_TAG, foreground=HEADER_COLOR[index])


def fill_preview(textbox, files):
    """
    Inserts the files into a CTkTextbox with syntax colors.

    The preview is truncated at PREVIEW_LIMIT characters to keep the window fast.
    """
    # The underlying tk.Text is much faster for many small inserts.
    widget = textbox._textbox
    _configure_tags(widget)

    used = 0
    truncated = False

    for relative_path, content in files:
        header = format_header(relative_path)
        widget.insert("end", header, HEADER_TAG)
        used += len(header)

        budget = PREVIEW_LIMIT - used
        if budget <= 0:
            truncated = True
            break

        # Cut the content before lexing, so huge files are not processed needlessly.
        if len(content) > budget:
            content = content[:budget]
            truncated = True

        for token_type, value in lex(content, _lexer_for(relative_path, content)):
            widget.insert("end", value, _tag_for(token_type))

        widget.insert("end", "\n\n\n")
        used += len(content) + 3

        if truncated:
            break

    if truncated:
        widget.insert(
            "end",
            "... preview truncated. Copy and Save include the full text.",
            HEADER_TAG,
        )

main.py

"""Entry point: starts the Project Code Exporter GUI."""

from gui import run

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run()



============================================================
README.md
============================================================

<h1 align="center">CodeCollector</h1>

<p align="center">
  A simple desktop app that collects a project's source code into a single text file - ready to paste into an AI chat or share.
</p>

<p align="center">
  <img src="https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.10+-3776AB?logo=python&logoColor=white" alt="Python 3.10+">
  <img src="https://img.shields.io/badge/GUI-CustomTkinter-1f6aa5" alt="CustomTkinter">
  <img src="https://img.shields.io/badge/Highlighting-Pygments-2b7a78" alt="Pygments">
</p>

---

## About the project

CodeCollector walks through a project folder, picks up the source files worth sharing and joins them into one text file. Every file is preceded by a header with its relative path, so the result stays easy to read and navigate. After the export, the app shows a colorized preview where you can save the file to a location of your choice or copy everything to the clipboard.

## Features

**Collecting code**
- Recursively collects source files from the selected project folder
- Skips directories such as `.git`, `.idea`, `.vscode`, `__pycache__`, `venv`, `node_modules`, `dist` and `build`
- Supports many languages (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#, Java, Kotlin, C/C++, Go, Rust, PHP, Swift, Dart, SQL, HTML/CSS and common config formats)
- Reads files in several encodings (UTF-8, UTF-8 with BOM, CP1250, Latin-1)
- Asks for confirmation before processing very large projects

**Result window**
- Syntax-highlighted preview, adapted to the light and dark theme
- Save location shown up front (defaults to the project folder) and changeable with a "Save as" dialog
- **Save file** writes the full text to the chosen path
- **Copy all** copies the full, uncolored text to the clipboard

**Interface**
- Clean, minimal window built with CustomTkinter
- Follows the system light/dark mode
- Progress indicator while the project is being scanned

## Architecture

The code is split into small modules with a single responsibility each:

```
CodeCollector/
├── main.py            # Entry point
├── gui.py             # Main window: folder selection and Generate button
├── result_window.py   # Result window: preview, save location, Save / Copy all
├── highlight.py       # Syntax highlighting of the preview (Pygments)
├── exporter.py        # Collecting, reading and joining files, saving the result
├── config.py          # Ignored folders, file extensions, limits, fonts
└── requirements.txt   # Python dependencies
```

### Configuration

All tunable settings live in `config.py`:

- **`IGNORE_DIRS` / `IGNORE_FILES`**: folders and files that are never exported
- **`INCLUDE_EXTENSIONS`**: file extensions that are exported
- **`WARNING_FILE_LIMIT`**: number of files above which the app asks for confirmation
- **`PREVIEW_LIMIT`**: maximum number of characters shown in the preview (saving and copying always use the full text)
- **`OUTPUT_FILE_NAME`**: default name of the generated file

## Tech stack

| Layer | Technologies |
| --- | --- |
| Language | Python 3 |
| GUI | CustomTkinter (Tkinter) |
| Syntax highlighting | Pygments |

## Getting started

Requires Python 3.10 or newer.

1. Clone the repository:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Narothe/CodeCollector.git
cd CodeCollector
```

2. Create a virtual environment and install the dependencies:

```bash
python -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\activate        # Windows
source .venv/bin/activate     # macOS / Linux
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

3. Run the app:

```bash
python main.py
```

### Usage

1. Click **Browse** and select the project folder.
2. Click **Generate**.
3. In the result window, check the preview and choose what to do:
   - **Save file** - writes `project_code.txt` to the path shown in the *Save to* field (use **Change...** to pick another location),
   - **Copy all** - copies everything to the clipboard,
   - **Close** - closes the window without saving.

## Author

- [Narothe](https://github.com/Narothe)

============================================================
result_window.py
============================================================

"""The window shown after export: preview, save location, Save / Copy all / Close."""

from pathlib import Path

import customtkinter as ctk
from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox

from config import CODE_FONT, FONT
from exporter import default_output_path, files_to_text, save_text
from highlight import fill_preview

MUTED_TEXT = ("gray35", "gray70")
SUCCESS_TEXT = ("#1a7f37", "#4ac26b")


class ResultWindow(ctk.CTkToplevel):
    """Shows the collected code and lets the user save it or copy it."""

    def __init__(self, app, folder, files, status_var):
        super().__init__(app)

        self.app = app
        self.status_var = status_var
        self.text = files_to_text(files)  # full text used by Save and Copy
        self.files = files

        self.path_var = ctk.StringVar(value=str(default_output_path(folder)))
        self.result_var = ctk.StringVar(value="")

        self.title("Export ready")
        self.geometry("820x640")
        self.minsize(600, 460)
        self.transient(app)  # keep above the main window
        self.after(100, self.focus)

        self._build_header()
        self._build_preview()
        self._build_save_row()
        self._build_buttons()

    # ---- UI construction ----

    def _build_header(self):
        ctk.CTkLabel(
            self, text="Export ready", font=(FONT, 20, "bold"), anchor="w"
        ).pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=(18, 0))

        ctk.CTkLabel(
            self,
            text=(
                f"{len(self.files):,} files collected ({len(self.text):,} characters). "
                "Save it to a file or copy everything."
            ),
            font=(FONT, 13),
            text_color=MUTED_TEXT,
            justify="left",
            anchor="w",
        ).pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=(2, 10))

    def _build_preview(self):
        box = ctk.CTkTextbox(
            self, font=(CODE_FONT, 12), corner_radius=10, wrap="none"
        )
        box.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=20)

        fill_preview(box, self.files)
        box.configure(state="disabled")  # read-only (selecting and Ctrl+C still work)

    def _build_save_row(self):
        row = ctk.CTkFrame(self, fg_color="transparent")
        row.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=(12, 0))

        ctk.CTkLabel(row, text="Save to:", font=(FONT, 13)).pack(
            side="left", padx=(0, 8)
        )

        ctk.CTkButton(
            row, text="Change...", width=90, height=32, command=self.change_location
        ).pack(side="right", padx=(8, 0))

        ctk.CTkEntry(
            row, textvariable=self.path_var, height=32, corner_radius=8
        ).pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True)

        # Confirmation line ("Saved: ..." / "Copied ...") shown under the row.
        ctk.CTkLabel(
            self,
            textvariable=self.result_var,
            font=(FONT, 12),
            anchor="w",
            text_color=SUCCESS_TEXT,
        ).pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=(8, 0))

    def _build_buttons(self):
        row = ctk.CTkFrame(self, fg_color="transparent")
        row.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=(8, 18))

        ctk.CTkButton(
            row, text="Save file", width=130, height=36, command=self.save
        ).pack(side="left")

        ctk.CTkButton(
            row, text="Copy all", width=130, height=36, command=self.copy_all
        ).pack(side="left", padx=10)

        ctk.CTkButton(
            row,
            text="Close",
            width=100,
            height=36,
            fg_color="transparent",
            border_width=1,
            text_color=("gray10", "gray90"),
            command=self.destroy,
        ).pack(side="right")

    # ---- Actions ----

    def change_location(self):
        """Lets the user pick the output file with the system 'Save as' dialog."""
        current = Path(self.path_var.get())

        chosen = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(
            parent=self,
            title="Choose where to save",
            initialdir=str(current.parent),
            initialfile=current.name,
            defaultextension=".txt",
            filetypes=[("Text file", "*.txt"), ("All files", "*.*")],
        )

        if chosen:
            self.path_var.set(str(Path(chosen)))

    def save(self):
        """Writes the full text to the path currently shown in the entry."""
        target = self.path_var.get().strip()

        if not target:
            messagebox.showwarning("Warning", "Choose where to save.", parent=self)
            return

        try:
            output = save_text(target, self.text)
        except OSError as error:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", str(error), parent=self)
            return

        self.result_var.set(f"Saved: {output}")
        self.status_var.set(f"Saved ✓ ({output.name})")

    def copy_all(self):
        """Copies the full text (without colors) to the clipboard."""
        self.app.clipboard_clear()
        self.app.clipboard_append(self.text)
        self.app.update()  # keeps the clipboard content alive after the window closes

        self.result_var.set("Copied everything to the clipboard ✓")
